scientific_scope: fixed-pool deployment-condition mismatch; not a new blinded prospective experiment and not a historical optimization trajectory

data.unselected_role: construction/growth-bias control only; excluded from directional regret
data.score_semantics: experimentally derived log10 selected/unselected enrichment ratio corrected by WT; not direct enzyme activity, MIC, or clinical response
data.missing_values: NA/empty/NaN excluded; never imputed across conditions

split.method: sort positions by SHA256('scenario_tem1_v1|split|20261127|position'), then assign first 60% train, next 20% dev, remainder test
split.model_fitting: none; one experimental condition is directly used as proxy
split.test_policy: run once only after implementation and dev checks pass; no direction-dependent protocol revision

pools.membership: variants with nonmissing scores in all five Amp conditions and cefotaxime; same membership reused for every source-target direction
pools.rng: NumPy default_rng seeded by the first 8 bytes of SHA256('scenario_tem1_v1|pool|20261128|position|N|replicate')
pools.minimum_complete_variants: N; otherwise no pool for that position and N
pools.tie_break: maximum score, then lexicographically smallest hgvs_pro

directions.absolute_regret_cross_concentration_comp: descriptive only because scale can change

estimands.bon_regret: maximum target score in the fixed N pool minus target score of the maximum-proxy pick
estimands.random_n_regret: maximum target score minus the exact arithmetic mean of all N target scores; this is the expected regret of one uniform random pick from the same N candidates
estimands.primary_effect: BoN regret minus RandomN regret; negative favors proxy BoN
estimands.selection_turnover_proxy_vs_oracle: fraction of pools whose proxy pick differs from the deterministic target oracle pick
estimands.selection_turnover_source_oracle_vs_targ: fraction of pools whose source-condition oracle pick differs from target-condition oracle pick
estimands.global_correlation: Pearson and Spearman over all split variants with paired nonmissing scores
estimands.top_tail_correlation: Spearman within source-proxy top decile and within target top decile, using ceiling(0.1*n) and deterministic score/HGVS ranking

bootstrap.method: nonparametric percentile cluster bootstrap over complete amino-acid positions
bootstrap.same_position_resample_shared_across_dir: shared across all directions within each N; eligible position set is N-specific because positions with fewer than N complete variants cannot form a fixed-size pool
bootstrap.pool_replicates_within_position: kept paired; cross-condition scores of a variant are never treated as independent

local_desensitized: report without per-variant labels or raw files

verification: round 1: raw hashes, variant alignment, missingness, split isolation, pool size/membership and arithmetic fixtures
round 2: independent implementation recomputes all test selections, regrets, correlations and bootstrap intervals without importing production code
round 3: delivery hashes, report-number reconciliation, one-time test execution log and absence of local raw/per-variant files
